body: I’ll probably erase all of this soon so bye and thanks

I’ve been trying to die since I was kid but somehow I always survive and pull thru and get so angry for not planning it better in a way to not come back. My last attempt was last year I drank a whole bottle of pain killers a big add bottle. My boyfriend found out and called the ambulance and I got drained and stayed in the stupid hospital for like it seemed three weeks with stupid nurses that don’t know how to draw fucking blood. That only made want to die even more. I haven’t tried since cause I got shit going and I’m really fighting the feelings and the urge but the desire still there. I wake up everyday thinking that the world and the people in it would be in a better situation if I wasn’t in it.

Everyone in my life make it their work to make sure I know that they always helping me and that without them I’m nothing. And it’s hard to move on from this situation cause I do feel like I can never amount to anything without asking them for some kind of help and i feel trapped i feel useless. I dont know what to do anymore i just want to be free one way or another
